ws2812_init.message0: Initialize WS2812 strip data pin %1 LED count %2
ws2812_init.tooltip: Initialize a WS2812 strip on the selected data pin with RMT hardware timing; call before other strip blocks on the same pin; re-initializing the same pin reconfigures it automatically

ws2812_fill.message0: WS2812 fill all LEDs data pin %1 red %2 green %3 blue %4
ws2812_fill.tooltip: Set all LEDs of this pin's strip buffer to the given RGB color (0-255); takes effect after a refresh block

ws2812_set_pixel.message0: WS2812 set one LED data pin %1 index %2 red %3 green %4 blue %5
ws2812_set_pixel.tooltip: Set the RGB color (0-255) of the LED at the given zero-based index on this pin's strip; takes effect after a refresh block

ws2812_set_brightness.message0: WS2812 set brightness data pin %1 brightness %2
ws2812_set_brightness.tooltip: Set overall brightness 0-255 for this pin's strip, applied on the next refresh

ws2812_clear.tooltip: Turn all LEDs of this pin's strip off in the buffer; call the refresh block to actually switch them off

ws2812_show.tooltip: Send this pin's strip buffer to the LEDs via RMT hardware timing and display it

ws2812_is_ready.tooltip: Returns 1 if this pin's strip was initialized successfully, 0 if not initialized or initialization failed (for example no free RMT channel)
